description: This PHP file defines the SocialMediaAuthenticationService class within the OrangeHRM system. It handles social media authentication processes, particularly involving OpenID Connect protocols, for user login via various social media providers. The class includes methods for initiating authentication, managing user identities, and verifying configuration settings related to social media login features.

classes.name: SocialMediaAuthenticationService
classes.description: Service class for managing social media authentication via OpenID Connect in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAuthProviderDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of the AuthProviderDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getUserDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of the UserDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: initiateAuthentication
methods.description: Sets up and returns an OpenIDConnectClient instance for starting authentication with a specified provider and scope, redirect URL.

methods.name: getRedirectURL
methods.description: Generates and returns the URL to redirect users for OIDC login.

methods.name: getScope
methods.description: Returns the scope string used for OIDC authentication.

methods.name: getSystemUsers
methods.description: Retrieves system users matching the given user credentials.

methods.name: getUserForAuthenticate
methods.description: Authenticates and returns a user based on provided credentials, throwing exceptions for various failure states.

methods.name: setOIDCUserIdentity
methods.description: Creates and saves a user identity linked to an OpenID provider.

methods.name: handleOIDCAuthentication
methods.description: Sets credentials for a user as part of the authentication process.

methods.name: isSocialMediaAuthEnable
methods.description: Checks whether social media authentication providers are enabled and available.
